scenarios.name: Open the context menus for a selected solid face

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software is in the part modeling workspace with no command or modal dialog active
`fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with a solid face selected
a radial shortcut menu appears near the pointer
the radial menu includes "Extrude", "Select Other...", "Select Tangencies", and "New Sketch"
the standard menu includes "Properties" and "Export Face As..."
